description:
The / command menu is significantly different/limited in the Elixir version.

OBSERVED (Elixir - left):
→ /clear      Clear the conversation
  /compact    Compact conversation context
  /config     Show current configuration
  /cost       Show token usage and costs
  /help       Show available commands and key bindings
  (1/10)

Only 5 commands shown, with pagination indicating 10 total.

EXPECTED (Node.js - right):
→ settings             Open settings menu
  model                Select model (opens selector UI)
  scoped-models        Enable/disable models for Ctrl+P cycli
  export               Export session (HTML default, or speci
  import               Import and resume a session from a JSO
  (1/23)

Many more commands including: settings, model, scoped-models, export, import, and likely 18+ more.

The Elixir version is missing most commands including: settings, model, scoped-models, export, import, and many others.

This suggests the command system is incomplete or the menu is showing a filtered subset.
title: TUI-7: / command menu has different/limited commands
